arguments.label: Entailment
arguments.explanation: Span 32 requires return and no retention of copies, but span 33 permits the receiving party to elect delivery of derived materials to outside legal counsel, where they are held in confidence except as needed in legal proceedings. Thus some Confidential Information may be retained after return/destruction.
